== Description ==
Historical full-card image of [[Luke's Ultimatum (Virtual Set 8: Jabba's Court)|Luke's Ultimatum]], the [[Virtual Set 8: Jabba's Court]] Effect renamed from Ultimatum (V) by the Players Committee on 15 August 2008. It combines the underlying Decipher card [[Ultimatum]] and the Virtual slip, with the renamed header "•Luke's Ultimatum" and the slip title "•Ultimatum (V)", slip 23.
